Hey @elonmusk I know you hate paying for advertising, but @TigerWoods endorsing @Tesla self drive is a no brainer at this point. #goldmine

Remember the Wade Houston era? As a kid my dad and I sat in the upper deck of Rupp and watched Kentucky win by 60. Stayed the entire game. My dad wanted us to hold the ball to keep them from getting 100.

Impressive. As a kid, we all just hoped for a tourney bid. Which almost never happened. Vols had one from 1984 to 1997 when I was growing up.

in a good spot

Holy crap @abbyhornacek getting suplexed like this on live TV and hopping up to close the segment is a heck of a comeback.

Video

Saturday in America (@SatAmericaFNC)

"No Kings" Rallies Continue Across Major Cities

@BuckSexton says, "The next time @ClayTravis and I have a political bet... the loser is going to have to show up to a 'No King's' protest wearing a 'Future Is Female' t-shirt..."🤣

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/SatAmericaFNC/status/2037903842537353292#m

Oh no, @TheChadWithrow!


Freezing Cold Takes (@OldTakesExposed)







— https://nitter.net/OldTakesExposed/status/2037890423125844030#m
To be fair, my wife may have bad vision. (There are hundreds of these, btw. I can’t even keep up).

Imagine waking up at 6:30 am on a Saturday morning and sending this email to a complete stranger. I’m fascinated by people like this. When she finished this email and hit send did she think, “Got him!” I need their stories.
Good morning, making friends, influencing people, it’s what I do! Thanks for the love, Nicole.

Barnes has been the underdog in all three Elite 8 games so far. Will take an extraordinary performance to win a default road game in Chicago against Michigan. But this team has peaked at the right time. Ament knee injury slowed them down late in SEC, but team is playing best now.

Tennessee had one elite 8 in program history when Rick Barnes joined the Vols. Barnes has now taken Tennessee to three straight Elite 8’s. Pretty phenomenal run, all time elite coach. Hope he never retires.

Ridiculous play for a big man here. Vols have dominated the glass, but turned it over way too much. Insanely physical game.
